reconstruction_pays_only_across_the_writ.name: reconstruction_pays_only_across_the_writer_gap

predictions.depends_on: (W_self,R1) and (W_other,R1) cells under C_v7 and C_r3 at 274x4 seeds, D* = D minus the C_pl_static placebo increment, margin = 1/3 of the measured Gate-0 verbatim gain (floor +10), cluster bootstrap over games
predictions.falsifier: the CI of D*(W_other,R1) - D*(W_self,R1) includes 0 or is negative, i.e. reconstruction helps the reader's own bank as much as or more than the foreign bank
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The falsifier is reachable (the self-bank cell exists and the proposal names the compression route), but the pre-registered margin at the Gate-0 floor is only ~3.3 net while the stated headline MDE is +/-5.7 for a single paired difference and this contrast is a difference of two paired differences (~+/-8), so the predicted effect sits inside the stated noise; the design also tilts D*(W_self) toward zero by construction, since format conversion is a no-op on the reader's own on-policy bank and the 2x-median length cap removes much of the wandering that compression would exploit.
predictions.fix: Pre-register the margin as the larger of 1/3 of the Gate-0 gain and the bootstrap half-width of the difference-of-differences (or require a Gate-0 gain >= 24 net), and raise the four headline cells to >= 8 seeds so the DiD half-width falls below the margin.

predictions.depends_on: (W_prox,R1) and (W_cap,R1) reconstruction and verbatim cells at 4 seeds, with W_prox verified within +/-5 net of W_self at k=0 and W_cap verified >= 8 net apart, same 1/3-of-Gate-0 margin
predictions.falsifier: D*(W_cap) - D*(W_self) exceeds the margin (capability governs) or D*(W_prox) - D*(W_self) falls below it (format distance does not matter)
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Both arms exist so the falsifier is reachable, but the same ~3.3-net margin lies inside the +/-5.7 (and ~+/-8 for a DiD) noise, and the capability clause is stated as an unbounded null ('< that margin') that any noise-sized estimate satisfies, so the capability half is confirmed by default; W_prox also confounds scaffold with T=0.7, so a positive result does not isolate format distance.
predictions.fix: Test the capability clause as an equivalence bound (TOST against a pre-registered net-point ceiling) and the prox-vs-cap contrast directly with its own CI, add a T=0.7 same-scaffold bank to separate temperature from phrasing, and power all four cells to the DiD half-width.

predictions.depends_on: (W_other,R1) at 4 seeds and (W_exp,R2) at 2 seeds, C_r3 versus token-matched C_v7, paired per-game differences
predictions.falsifier: S(C_v7) >= S(C_r3) in either cell, i.e. more verbatim items at equal tokens do as well as rewriting
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The comparator arm is present and the falsifier is reachable, but the +4 net margin is below the stated +/-5.7 half-width for the headline cell and half the +/-8 half-width for the 2-seed (W_exp,R2) cell, so neither cell can separate the predicted outcome from the falsifier.
predictions.fix: Run (W_exp,R2) at 4+ seeds and set the margin at or above the paired bootstrap half-width (or state the claim as a CI on S(C_r3)-S(C_v7) excluding 0 in both cells).

predictions.depends_on: C_pl_static and C_static for R1 at 4 seeds, with D(W_other,R1) = S(C_r3) - S(C_v7) as the denominator
predictions.falsifier: the memory-absent placebo captures >= 2/3 of D(W_other,R1), i.e. the gain is a generic planning step rather than adaptation of the foreign item
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The placebo cell can genuinely produce a large planning gain so the outcome is reachable, but the criterion is a ratio whose denominator D(W_other,R1) is a single paired difference with a +/-5.7 CI that will typically include 0, leaving the ratio unbounded and undefined in sign.
predictions.fix: Restate the placebo bound in absolute net points with its own CI (e.g. upper CI bound <= 2 net) and condition the test on D(W_other,R1) having a CI that excludes 0.

predictions.depends_on: (W_self,R2) C_v3 and C_r3 cells at 274x2 seeds; rho_v and rho_r share the denominator S(W_self policy reading its own bank, C_v3) - S(C_static)
predictions.falsifier: rho_r <= rho_v for R2, i.e. rewriting does not help EXAONE read Qwen3's experience
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Because both ratios share the same denominator and the same C_static term, the contrast reduces to the paired S(C_r3)-S(C_v3) difference at R2, where 0.15 of a denominator of order 10-20 net is ~1.5-3 net against a +/-8 half-width at 2 seeds; the comparison also gives reconstruction the k=3-vs-k=3 token advantage that P3 was designed to remove.
predictions.fix: Run (W_self,R2) at 4+ seeds, state the claim as net points on S(C_r3)-S(C_v3) with a margin at or above the CI half-width, and compare against C_v7 rather than C_v3.

predictions.depends_on: per-type breakdown of (W_exp,R1,C_r3) for look-at-in-light, a cell of about 45 games, exploratory
predictions.falsifier: look-at-in-light stays <= -4.8 net under C_r3
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: A ~45-game type cell has a half-width roughly 2.5x the 274-game +/-8, so a 4.8-net move is far inside noise, and the stated falsifier leaves a dead zone (any value strictly between -4.8 and 0 neither confirms nor falsifies).
predictions.fix: Define the falsifier as the CI on the paired per-type C_r3-minus-C_v3 difference covering 0 or below, and either pool the negative-verbatim types or raise games/seeds until the per-type half-width is under ~5 net.

shared_terms: P1-P4: D* subtracts the very placebo increment P4 tests, but since both writers are read by R1 the placebo term cancels in P1's across-writer difference, so P4's outcome cannot move P1 either way.
P1-P3: both rest on the same (W_other,R1) C_r3 and C_v7 cells - P3's contrast is exactly the D(W_other,R1) component of P1's D*.
P1-P2: both use D*(W_self,R1) as the reference term, so a single noisy self-bank cell sets the sign of two 'independent' predictions.
P3-P4: D(W_other,R1) is P3's estimand and P4's denominator, so P3 failing makes P4's ratio undefined.
P5-P1: the denominator of both rho_v and rho_r for W_self is the (W_self,R1,C_v3) cell, which is also a P1 arm; note rho_v(W_self,R1) = 1 by construction since W_self's writer policy is R1.

reconstruction_launders_planted_procedur.name: reconstruction_launders_planted_procedure_errors

predictions.depends_on: C_v3 x Op-A x 25/50% versus the 0% clean cells for R1, harm H as a paired per-game difference, 18 screening cells at 274x2 seeds (+/-8 net)
predictions.falsifier: H < 6 net at every rate and operation, i.e. the reader ignores planted procedure errors
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The falsifier is genuinely reachable in mechanism, but the +6 threshold is below the stated +/-8 screening half-width and the gate is a maximum over 18 cells with no multiplicity control, so under a true null some cell will clear +6 by chance and the falsifying outcome is nearly excluded by the selection rule rather than by the data.
predictions.fix: Pre-register Op-A at 50% for R1 as the single gate cell at 4 seeds and set the gate threshold at or above that cell's bootstrap half-width, reporting the other 17 cells as descriptive.

predictions.depends_on: C_r3 at the Gate-0 rate versus C_v3, persistence pi scored by string match on the appliance/receptacle token over ~820 retrieval events (+/-0.04) with a 100-rewrite manual audit, harm ratio at 4 seeds
predictions.falsifier: H(C_r3) <= 0.5 x H(C_v3) or pi < 0.25, i.e. the rewrite repairs the planted step
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: The falsifier is a disjunction and its pi branch is measured over retrieval events at +/-0.04, so pi < 0.25 versus pi >= 0.5 is cleanly separable and the reader can in principle re-derive the correct appliance from the task keyword (C_rule shows the mismatch is keyword-detectable), even though the harm-ratio branch alone would be inside noise at a barely-passing Gate 0 and there is a dead zone (e.g. pi ~0.35 with a 0.6 harm ratio confirms nothing).
predictions.fix: Split into P2a (pi, as stated) and P2b (harm ratio in net points sized against the 4-seed half-width), and close the dead zone by defining the falsifier as the complement of the prediction.

predictions.depends_on: offline critic (the reader judging plan correctness) applied to the original planted items and to the persisted C_r3 rewrites of the same items, recall over labelled retrieval events
predictions.falsifier: critic recall on rewrites >= recall on originals minus 0.05
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: Nothing in the construction forces the sign - a short rewritten plan can expose the wrong appliance against the reader's task more starkly than a long labelled trajectory does - and the 0.15 margin is roughly 2-4x the bootstrap half-width even on the reduced persisted subset.
predictions.fix: Confirm that the originals set is restricted to the same persisted items (as 'the same planted items' implies), otherwise the rewrite side is conditioned on persistence while the original side is not.

predictions.depends_on: the four C_g3 detection logs (W_self->R1, W_other->R2, W_other->R1, W_self->R2) at the Gate-0 rate, 4 seeds, banks type-balanced and length-matched so the diagonal is not a length contrast; recall CI ~+/-0.04
predictions.falsifier: either reader shows recall(own) >= recall(foreign), or both readers show low recall on the same bank regardless of reader (a pool property, not proximity)
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: The full 2x2 is run, so the pool-property alternative has its own arms and can win, and the 0.10 margin is set at twice the stated +/-0.04 detection CI; the only dependency is that the Gate-0 rate is chosen by the underpowered P1.

predictions.depends_on: C_gr3 at the Gate-0 rate and at 0%, recovery = 1 - H(C_gr3)/H(C_v3), gate precision from the detection logs, 4 seeds (+/-5.7)
predictions.falsifier: recovery < 50% of H(C_v3), or the 0% bank loses more than 4 net relative to C_v3
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Recovery is a ratio of two harms each carrying a +/-5.7 half-width against a denominator that Gate 0 only guarantees to be +6, so the 50% threshold is ~3 net and undefined in sign, and the 0% clause is an unbounded null that any noise-sized loss satisfies.
predictions.fix: Require H(C_v3) >= about 12 net before running P5, express recovery in net points with a CI, and test the 0% clause as a non-inferiority bound (TOST) at 4+ seeds.

predictions.depends_on: C_rule (appliance token versus task-type keyword) and C_g3 recall on the Op-A and Op-B banks
predictions.falsifier: C_g3 does not exceed C_rule's Op-B recall by 0.2, i.e. the cheap rule suffices
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: The stated falsifier turns entirely on C_g3's own Op-B recall, which is measured at +/-0.04 against a 0.2 margin and can plausibly be near zero (detecting a relabelled or truncated failure needs completion evidence), so the falsifier is reachable and separable - though the prediction's other two clauses are true by construction, since an appliance-versus-keyword rule cannot inspect completion (Op-B recall ~0) and Op-A is exactly the mismatch the rule tests.
predictions.fix: Drop the two C_rule clauses to descriptive statements and pre-register P6 solely as a CI on C_g3's Op-B recall, or add a completion-aware rule variant so C_rule's Op-B recall is not zero by construction.

shared_terms: P1-P2: H(C_v3) at the Gate-0 rate is P1's estimand and the denominator of P2's harm ratio, so a barely-passing Gate 0 sets P2's 0.75 threshold at ~4.5 net, inside the cell noise.
P1-P5: recovery = 1 - H(C_gr3)/H(C_v3) uses the same H(C_v3), so P1's realized value fixes P5's margin as well.
P1-P4: the Gate-0 rate selected by P1 is the contamination rate at which all four P4 detection logs are collected.
P2-P3: the persisted-rewrite set that defines pi in P2 is exactly the set the critic scores in P3, so a low pi both falsifies P2 and shrinks P3's sample.
P4-P5: gate precision/recall come from the same C_g3 detection logs, so P5's precision >= 0.7 clause and P4's recall contrast are computed from one set of events.
reconstruction_launders_planted_procedur.headline: P4

rewriter_trained_against_one_reader_matc.name: rewriter_trained_against_one_reader_matched_cost

predictions.depends_on: (A,C_RA), (A,C_RB), (B,C_RA), (B,C_RB) and C_vtok cells at 274x4 seeds; both rewriters share the pooled W_exp+W_other input bank and the Qwen3-32B backbone, only the in-loop reader differs; margin = 1/3 of I(R_A,A) with Gate 0 at >= 6 net
predictions.falsifier: the foreign-trained rewriter is within the margin of the reader-trained one on either reader, i.e. the rewrites are reader-agnostic cleaning
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The 2x2 does control for rewriter quality so equality is reachable, but the C_vtok term cancels algebraically in both differences (each reduces to a two-cell paired difference such as g(B,C_RB)-g(B,C_RA)) and the margin at the Gate-0 floor is only ~2 net against the stated +/-5.7 half-width, so the predicted effect lies inside the noise.
predictions.fix: Set the margin as an absolute net-point threshold at or above the 4-seed paired half-width (or raise the Gate-0 bar to >= 18 net), and add seeds to the four rewriter x reader cells.

predictions.depends_on: TF = I(R_A,r)/I(R_A,A) for A' (T=0.7, verified within +/-5 net of A), A'' (thinking, verified >= 8 net above A) and B, against C_vtok in each reader; non-headline readers at 274x2 seeds
predictions.falsifier: TF(R_A->B) >= TF(R_A->A'') (backbone change costs less transfer than the capability change) or TF(R_A->A') < 0.5
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Every TF is a ratio whose denominator I(R_A,A) is only guaranteed to be +6 with a +/-5.7 CI while the numerators carry +/-5.7 to +/-8, so the CI on each TF spans roughly a full ratio unit and the 0.5/0.75 cut points cannot be separated; A' is additionally sampled at T=0.7 (extra variance) and A'' is verified to sit >= 8 net higher at k=0, so its headroom, not its proximity, compresses TF(A'').
predictions.fix: Gate P2 on a large I(R_A,A) (e.g. >= 15 net), report increments in net points with CIs instead of ratios, run A'/A''/B at 4+ seeds, and add a headroom-matched control (e.g. A at a harder split) so the A'' arm is not a ceiling effect.

predictions.depends_on: the C_RA_empty cell for A (rewriter given task and no item) at 274x2 seeds, compared through I against g(A,C_vtok); C_RA_mis as the mismatched control
predictions.falsifier: the item-free rewriter keeps >= 2/3 of the increment, in which case the transfer measured is plan transfer
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: This is the right control and its falsifier is reachable (a rejection-sampled rewriter can easily learn generic ALFWorld plans), but the 1/3 threshold at the Gate-0 floor is ~2 net while C_RA_empty sits in the 2-seed tier at +/-8, so neither the confirming nor the falsifying value can be distinguished from zero.
predictions.fix: Run C_RA_empty and C_RA_mis at 4 seeds and pre-register an absolute ceiling in net points whose upper CI bound must fall below one third of the measured I(R_A,A).

predictions.depends_on: (B,C_selfcost) versus (B,C_RA) at 4 seeds, with R_A's ~4 training GPU-h converted to EXAONE episodes at the measured 20 episodes/min and read verbatim
predictions.falsifier: g(B,C_RA) - g(B,C_selfcost) >= +6 net, i.e. importing the foreign-trained rewriter beats the same GPU-hours of B's own experience
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The prediction's acceptance region is the unbounded null g(B,C_selfcost) >= g(B,C_RA) minus nothing, so it swallows the entire +/-5.7 noise band while the falsifier sits at +6, right at the stated MDE, meaning a true +6 advantage would be detected only about half the time and any null result confirms by default; the arm is also self-serving in that a few GPU-hours of extra bank is on the flat part of the bank-size curve.
predictions.fix: State P4 as a non-inferiority test with a pre-registered bound (TOST) at enough seeds that the half-width is well under the falsifier, and fix the GPU-hour-to-episode conversion and the C_selfcost bank size before the cells are run.

predictions.depends_on: (A,C_R0) at 274x2 seeds versus (A,C_RA) at 4 seeds; C_vtok cancels so the contrast is S(A,C_RA)-S(A,C_R0); R_A is QLoRA-SFT on success-filtered best-of-3 samples from R_0 itself at T=0.8, evaluated greedy
predictions.falsifier: the prompted rewriter is within 1/3 of I(R_A,A) of the trained one on the training reader
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Rejection-sampling distillation of R_0's own T=0.8 best-of-3 against greedy R_0 puts a construction-level thumb on the scale but does not exclude the falsifier (a one-epoch QLoRA on a small filtered set may not generalize to the 274 held-out games); the decisive problem is that the ~2-net margin sits inside the 2-seed +/-8 half-width of the C_R0 cell.
predictions.fix: Run C_R0 at 4 seeds, evaluate R_0 at the same best-of-3 budget it was distilled from, and state the claim as a CI on S(A,C_RA)-S(A,C_R0) excluding 0 with a margin at or above the half-width.

predictions.depends_on: a W_other-only retrieval condition for reader A under verbatim and C_RA, with EXAONE reading its own W_other bank as the ratio denominator
predictions.falsifier: the retained-gain ratio under C_RA does not rise, or falls, relative to the verbatim ratio
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: The Experiments section pools W_exp and W_other 'as the input bank for all rewriter training and evaluation' and the Conditions list contains no W_other-only cell and no (B, W_other, C_v3) denominator cell, so the falsifying outcome is reachable only through arms the design names in Estimands but never enumerates; even granted them, a 0.15 shift in a ratio whose denominator is one gain measured at +/-5.7 to +/-8 would be inside noise.
predictions.fix: Add explicit W_other-only retrieval cells for A under C_v3/C_vtok/C_RA plus the (B, W_other, C_v3) denominator cell at 4 seeds, and state the claim as a net-point difference with a CI rather than as a 0.15 shift in a ratio.

shared_terms: P1-P2-P3-P5: I(R_A,A) is the single Gate-0 quantity that sets the margin for P1, the denominator of every TF in P2, and the 1/3 thresholds in P3 and P5, so one barely-passing cell shrinks four thresholds at once.

P1: g(A,C_vtok) and g(B,C_vtok) cancel inside both of P1's differences, so the headline contrast is a plain C_RB-versus-C_RA cell difference and never tests either rewriter against token-matched verbatim.
P3-P5: both are differences of I's sharing the g(A,C_vtok) term, each collapsing to a two-cell paired difference at reader A.
P2-P4: g(B,C_RA) is the numerator of TF(R_A->B) and one side of P4's matched-cost comparison, so a null transfer to B simultaneously confirms P2's third clause and P4.
P2-P6: TF(R_A->A) and P6's ratio share the numerator g(A,C_RA) minus the verbatim gain on reader A, differing only in the denominator.
rewriter_trained_against_one_reader_matc.headline: P1

self_pool_break_even.name: self_pool_break_even

predictions.depends_on: Qwen3-32B reader at k=3, paired 274 validation games x 2 seeds; self-pool budget sweep cells at b=10% (two independent draws) vs self-100%, both success-filtered on-policy pools, scored net of k=0 and the static-procedure prompt, with the b=0.5%/m=1 sensitivity control.
predictions.falsifier: Either 10% draw is at least 8 net below the full self pool with the paired CI excluding 0.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: At b=10% the low-p_t low-f_t types can fall below three same-type items, so an 8-net aggregate deficit is reachable through the near-duplicate/coverage channel the proposal names, and the mandatory b=0.5%/m=1 control shows the sweep can resolve an 8-net drop; the equivalence margin does equal the stated +/-8 cell noise floor, so a true 7-net deficit still scores as confirmation.

predictions.depends_on: Coverage cells (arm D): bank capped at m in {1,3,10} same-type items per type at full budget for the self and expert banks, k=3 retrieval, compared with m=all.
predictions.falsifier: m=3 is at least 8 net below m=all in either bank.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: With k=3 the retriever can inject at most three same-type items, so a cap at m=3 removes no item the reader would otherwise have seen and the count channel the prediction calls saturation is fixed by construction; only within-type match quality can produce the falsifier, and no arm separates that channel.
predictions.fix: Cross the coverage cap with retrieval depth (m=3 at k=7, or m=3 vs m=all at k=1), or add an m=3 cell whose three retained items are the worst-matched same-type items, so the item-count axis is testable apart from which three items the retriever returns.

predictions.depends_on: Expert-full (Measurement A) vs self-100% cells for the Qwen3 reader at k=3, paired on the same games, net of k=0 and the static prompt; retained-gain ratio reported only when the denominator CI excludes 0.
predictions.falsifier: Expert minus self at least 8 net with CI excluding 0 (the reverse, self beating expert by 8, is also reported).
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: Nothing in the construction ties the 1,465 replayed walkthroughs to the 1,892 on-policy successes and both directions are reported, so an 8-net separation at the stated floor is reachable; note the two stated criteria can disagree, since self +10 vs expert +17 satisfies the 8-net clause while breaking the 1.3 ratio bound.

predictions.depends_on: Per-type deficits of the b=2.5% self cells relative to self-100%, pooled over two draws and (as stated) both readers and both k, rank-correlated with 1/(p_t f_t) over the six ALFWorld task types.
predictions.falsifier: Spearman rho at most 0.2, or heat not among the two largest per-type deficits.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: rho is computed over six points from per-type deficits whose cells are roughly 45 games (per-type noise far exceeds the deficits being ranked), so 0.6 and 0.2 are not separable and 0.2-0.6 is a dead zone; the stated pooling is also unavailable because b=2.5% cells exist only for the Qwen3 reader at k=3 (arm E has only 100%/10% at k=1, arm F only 100%/10% for EXAONE).
predictions.fix: Add b=2.5% cells for the EXAONE reader and for k=1, and attach a paired-bootstrap CI to rho (or replace the rank test with a per-type regression of deficit on 1/(p_t f_t) with a stated MDE).

predictions.depends_on: Writer-swap cells: EXAONE reader on own-100% vs Qwen3-100%, and Qwen3 reader on self-100% vs EXAONE-100%, k=3, paired on the same games and seeds.
predictions.falsifier: Own minus other at least 8 net with CI excluding 0 in either reader.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: Both pools and both swap directions are actually run, so an own-pool proximity advantage above the stated floor is reachable; the falsifier is one-sided, so the other backbone's pool beating the reader's own by 10 net would break the literal within-8 claim without triggering the stated falsifier.

shared_terms: P1-P2: both deficits are scored against the same self-100% (m=all) full-bank cell, so a mis-estimate of that single cell moves both.
P1-P4: P4's per-type deficits are the per-type decomposition of the same self-b vs self-100% difference P1 aggregates, so a confirmed P1 bounds the deficits P4 then has to rank.
P3-P5: both are differences taken against the same Qwen3 self-100% cell (expert minus self; other minus own), so that shared term determines both.
self_pool_break_even.headline: P1

reader_pays_writer_detours.name: reader_pays_writer_detours

predictions.depends_on: Qwen3 reader at k=3, the two manipulation pairs (expert vs expert-padded; self-raw vs self-pruned), within-game paired regression of the change in reader steps on the change in top-1 item steps, restricted to successful episodes; power claimed from about 500 paired successful episodes per pair at SD about 6 steps.
predictions.falsifier: The slope's 95% CI upper bound is at most 0.1 in both pairs.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: A cell is 274 games x 2 seeds = 548 episodes, so about 500 paired successful episodes would require over 90% joint success in both arms, which no stated number supports; at the attainable count the slope SE is far too large for a CI upper bound of 0.1, so even a true zero slope cannot reach the falsifier, and conditioning on success drops exactly the cap-hitting detour-copying episodes that carry the effect.
predictions.fix: Run the manipulation pairs at enough seeds or games to actually deliver about 500 paired successful episodes, or estimate the slope over all episodes with step-cap censoring modeled, and state the achieved SE rather than a pilot assumption.

predictions.depends_on: self-pruned vs self-raw success cells for both readers at k=3, paired on 274 games x 2 seeds, with rule-based vs random-deletion pruning ablation.
predictions.falsifier: Pruned at least 6 net below raw with CI excluding 0.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The 6-net neutrality margin is set below the proposal's own stated +/-8 cell noise floor, so the falsifier lies inside the stated noise and within-6-net is confirmed by insensitivity rather than by evidence.
predictions.fix: State the paired (not cell) success MDE and add seeds or games until it is below 6 net, or raise the neutrality margin to the resolvable floor.

predictions.depends_on: expert vs expert-padded success cells at k=3, with detours replay-verified benign and token-matched by observation truncation.
predictions.falsifier: Padded at least 6 net below expert.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Same 6-net threshold under the stated +/-8 floor, and the padding is replay-verified benign and token-matched, so item content is preserved by construction and only a distraction effect smaller than the cell noise could produce the falsifier.
predictions.fix: Set the neutrality margin at or above the resolvable paired MDE (more seeds), and add a deliberately non-benign padding arm (replay-failing detours) as the sensitivity control showing the cell can detect content damage at all.

predictions.depends_on: Qwen3 expert vs self-raw cells at k=3 with per-episode consumer-token accounting from vLLM usage fields; gain per 1k consumer tokens plus the paired net-success gap.
predictions.falsifier: self-raw's gain per consumer token is at least the expert's, or the success gap is at least 8 net.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: The second falsifier disjunct is a plain 8-net success comparison at the stated cell floor and is genuinely reachable, although the 25% confirm threshold carries no CI for a ratio whose numerator inherits the +/-8 net noise (about 30% of the +27 reference effect).

predictions.depends_on: EXAONE reader on Qwen3-raw vs Qwen3-pruned, same within-game paired slope estimand, judged against the Qwen3 self-reader slope from P1.
predictions.falsifier: Slope CI upper bound at most 0.1 for the foreign reader while at least 0.3 for the self reader.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: It inherits P1's paired-successful-episode shortfall on a cell with no more episodes and adds a conjunction on the self-reader slope, so if P1 is itself unresolved, or both slopes are null, the falsifier can never be triggered.
predictions.fix: Power the EXAONE manipulation pair to the same paired-success count as the self reader and restate the falsifier as a stated difference between the two slopes with its own CI, instead of a conjunction of two one-sided bounds.

shared_terms: P1-P5: P5 is the same length-inheritance slope on a second reader and its falsifier is defined relative to P1's slope, so P1's estimate decides whether P5 can resolve at all.
P1-P4: reader steps in P1's slope and consumer tokens in P4's denominator are the same measured episode length (tokens are generated per step), so a positive P1 mechanically produces P4's token gap.
P2-P4: P4's 'success gaps within 8 net' clause and the neutrality tests share the same self-raw and expert net-gain terms, so the pruning and padding cells fix the numerator of the cost ratio.
reader_pays_writer_detours.headline: P1

leave_one_type_out_split.name: leave_one_type_out_split

predictions.depends_on: Six LOTO banks per writer, k=3 retrieval cells for three writers x two readers, gains vs k=0 measured on valid_unseen, paired against the same writers' standard-bank cells, with game-level stratified bootstrap CIs.
predictions.falsifier: Any LOTO cell shows at least +12 net with CI excluding +8.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The headline comparison is scored on valid_unseen only (about 134 of the 274 games), so the asserted +/-8 floor, justified by the claim that the LOTO composite keeps the full 274 x 2 cell, does not apply; at the unseen-half noise (roughly +/-11) confirmation needs a point estimate near or below zero and the falsifier needs about +20, leaving almost the whole plausible range unresolved.
predictions.fix: Define the headline on the full 274 x 2 LOTO composite (or run 4 seeds on valid_unseen) and set the +8/+12 bands from the actual unseen-cell CI so the confirm and falsify regions are separated by more than the noise.

predictions.depends_on: Standard and LOTO cells for three writers x two readers; LOTO harm vs k=0 and Kendall tau between the within-type gain ranking and the LOTO harm ranking over three writers in both readers, gated on the wrong-procedure graft producing at least 6 net harm.
predictions.falsifier: Expert LOTO at or above -2 net (no harm), or the two rankings disagree.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Both parts sit under the proposal's own +/-8 floor (a 6-net harm claim and a -2 net cut are inside cell noise), and exact tau=1 over three writers whose gains almost certainly differ by less than the floor is decided by noise, so rank disagreement fires near-certainly regardless of the mechanism.
predictions.fix: Replace exact tau=1 with a pre-registered adjacent-writer gap at or above the resolvable margin, and add seeds so a 6-net LOTO harm lies outside the paired CI.

predictions.depends_on: Multi-LoRA adapter cells on the full 274 x 2 composite: LOTO adapter composite memory-absent vs base k=0, vs LOTO retrieval of the same expert pool, and all-type adapter vs within-type k=3 expert retrieval, at matched cost.
predictions.falsifier: LOTO adapter at most +4, or LOTO retrieval at or above the LOTO adapter, or the all-type adapter at or above within-type retrieval.
predictions.label: open
predictions.reason: The falsifier is a disjunction of three comparisons, two of them plain sign comparisons that any outcome resolves, and adapter overfitting to the trained types is a live outcome that full-size composite cells can show.

predictions.depends_on: LOTO adapter composite vs the token-matched five-procedure static prompt (target type omitted) on the same 274 games x 2 seeds.
predictions.falsifier: static-5 at or above adapter minus 4 net.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The confirm threshold (6 net) and the falsify threshold (4 net) both lie below the stated +/-8 cell noise floor and are only 2 net apart, so the comparison cannot come out either way at the stated power.
predictions.fix: Add seeds to the adapter and static-5 cells until the paired MDE is under 4 net, and state one decision boundary instead of a 4-to-6 dead zone.

predictions.depends_on: The 4-seed LOTO self-pool cell for the Qwen3 reader, split into valid_seen and valid_unseen halves, with a stated 10-net margin for the halved-cell decomposition.
predictions.falsifier: Seen minus unseen at most 2 net under LOTO for the self writer.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The estimand is a contrast between two non-overlapping half-cells (about 140 and 134 games at 4 seeds) whose difference carries roughly sqrt(2) times the half-cell noise, so a 2-net falsifier is deep inside that noise and 2-to-10 is a dead zone.
predictions.fix: State the MDE for the seen-minus-unseen contrast itself and add seeds until 2 net lies outside its CI, or replace the split with a per-game room-overlap covariate regressed on the LOTO gain.

shared_terms: P1-P2: P2's within-type gain ranking is read off the same standard-bank cells P1 requires to reach +16, and its harm term is the same LOTO gain P1 bounds at +8, so one set of cells determines both.
P1-P3: P3's clause that the LOTO adapter exceeds LOTO retrieval by 8 uses the same LOTO expert retrieval cell P1 bounds, so a confirmed P1 supplies that conjunct as soon as the adapter clears +8.
P3-P4: both are differences against the same LOTO adapter composite cell, so an error in that single cell moves both.
P1-P5: P5's unseen term is the valid_unseen LOTO self cell that P1 already caps at +8, so P1 bounds the quantity P5 must exceed by 10.
leave_one_type_out_split.headline: P1

complementarity_not_proximity.name: complementarity_not_proximity

predictions.depends_on: Cells Q-prox->Q, Q-cap->Q, Q-prox->E, Q-cap->E at 4 seeds; the screened Q-prox writer (k=0 within +/-3 of Q-self, pi lower by >= 0.15) and the Q-cap writer (k=0 >= Q-self + 8, thoughts stripped); rho against each reader's own matched-cost pool, net of the static-procedure prompt.
predictions.falsifier: The proximity contrast |rho(Q-prox)-rho(Q-self)| exceeds the capability contrast, or the capability contrast rho(Q-cap)-rho(Q-self) is <= 0.10.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Both arms exist and either outcome is mechanically reachable, but the stated noise swallows the margins: the proposal itself maps rho 0.15-0.20 to 5-7 net points on reader Q's ~35-point self-pool gain against a +/-8 net floor at 2 seeds (~+/-5.7 at 4 seeds, i.e. rho +/-0.16), so the 0.20-wide gap between the predicted >0.30 and the falsifying <=0.10 is about one CI half-width for Q, the equivalence half (|delta| < 0.20) is an untested TOST inside that same band, and for reader E, whose self-pool gain may be under 20 net points (the proposal concedes this), rho noise is >= 0.28 and both thresholds vanish.
predictions.fix: Pre-register a paired MDE on rho itself (not on net points), require each reader's own-pool gain >= 25 net or raise seeds until the rho CI half-width is <= 0.08, and state the equivalence half as a TOST with its own margin instead of a bare |delta| < 0.20.

predictions.depends_on: The 12 cross cells at k=3, the offline kappa table (writer per-type success from the collection run vs reader k=0 per-type success), the offline pi table (300 stratified states), and rho against the reader's own success-filtered pool at matched episode budget.
predictions.falsifier: A cell with kappa > 0.05 and rho < 0.85, a cell with kappa < 0.02 and rho > 1.15, or partial Spearman(rho, pi | kappa) > 0.5.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: The estimand re-describes how the pools were built: every pool is success-filtered from the writer's own collection run, so the writer's per-type success (the very quantity kappa is computed from) is proportional to how many items of each type the pool contains, while the reader's own pool is by construction thinnest on exactly the types where the reader fails; kappa > 0.05 therefore means the foreign pool carries items on types the denominator pool cannot cover, and rho < 0.85 there is reachable only through a mechanism the proposal names but never manipulates (a format or serialization threshold that makes covering items unusable); separately the correlational half is underpowered, since with n=12 cells a Spearman SE is about 0.30, so the null band [-0.3, 0.3] for the partial correlation and the >0.6 threshold are both inside one SE.
predictions.fix: Add a de-confounding arm that breaks the coverage/kappa identity - e.g. a foreign pool subsampled to the reader-failure types at the same item count as the reader's own pool on those types, or a high-kappa pool deliberately serialized in a foreign format - and either raise the cell count or drop the Spearman thresholds in favour of the pre-registered 2x2 Fisher test, which is the only powered part.

predictions.depends_on: The per-type breakdown of the top three foreign cells at 4 seeds, the p_R < 0.5 split of the six task types into reader-failure vs reader-success groups, and net gain measured over the reader's own success-filtered pool.
predictions.falsifier: The gain over the reader's own pool is spread evenly across the two type groups or concentrated on reader-success types.
predictions.label: entailed
predictions.reason: Two constructions force the sign: the groups are defined by the reader's own k=0 success (p_R < 0.5 vs >= 0.5), so the success group is near ceiling and can absorb only (1 - p_R) of any gain, and the comparison pool is the reader's own success-filtered bank, which by definition holds few items on the types where the reader fails - so any net gain over that denominator must land in the failure group, and >= 70 percent is close to arithmetically guaranteed rather than a test of where complementarity acts.
predictions.fix: Score the share against a headroom-proportional null (expected share given each group's 1 - p_R and episode counts) rather than an even split, and include reader-success types with real residual headroom (p_R in 0.5-0.8) as a separate group so the falsifying concentration is attainable.

predictions.depends_on: The self-opt vs self-rand cells for reader Q at 4 seeds, where self-opt is length-filtered own successes on the reader-failure types and self-rand is a random subset of equal size at the same collection cost.
predictions.falsifier: rho(self-opt) - rho(self-rand) <= 0.05, i.e. the capability term does not act through trajectory optimality.
predictions.label: near_entailed
predictions.reason: The two arms differ in two ways at once - length filtering and restriction to the reader-failure types - so the arm that would isolate optimality is absent: self-opt is targeted at exactly the high-headroom group that P3 shows carries the gain, which pushes the contrast positive for coverage reasons the proposal never separates, and the 0.20 margin is itself only about 7 net points against a ~5.7-net 4-seed CI.
predictions.fix: Add a third arm - own successes restricted to the reader-failure types with lengths sampled at random (no length filter) - so that self-opt vs that arm varies only optimality, and report all three at seeds sufficient for a rho CI half-width below 0.08.

predictions.depends_on: The three token-matched placebo cells (unrelated-type trajectories at the k=3 token count), one per reader, at 2 seeds.
predictions.falsifier: The placebo gains >= 8 net points for some reader, showing context length alone helps.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Reachable in principle - unrelated-type ALFWorld trajectories still carry format, valid action syntax and generic navigation procedure - but the placebo cells sit at 2 seeds where the proposal states a +/-8 net floor, so the predicted band (|net| < 4) lies entirely inside the noise and the falsifying value (8) is the noise floor itself; a null here cannot be distinguished from an unmeasured +8 contamination of every rho.
predictions.fix: Raise the placebo cells to the same 4 seeds as P1/P3/P4 (or more) and state the equivalence claim as a paired MDE - the placebo must be shown to be below, say, 3 net with an upper CI bound under 4, not merely to fall short of 8.

shared_terms: P2-P3: kappa is defined on the reader's per-type k=0 success, the same p_R < 0.5 grouping P3 scores the gain on, and both use the same success-filtered own pool as denominator, so any cell satisfying P2 has its gain located in P3's group by construction.

P1-P2: rho(Q-prox->Q), rho(Q-cap->Q) and the two E cells are members of P2's 12-cell correlation, and Q-cap is screened on the same k=0 per-type success that enters kappa, so P1's capability contrast is one point on P2's kappa-rho slope.
P3-P4: self-opt is defined as own successes on the reader-failure types, the exact group whose gain share P3 measures, so a positive P4 mechanically reinforces P3's concentration and vice versa.

P1-P2-P3-P4: every rho subtracts the same per-reader static-procedure baseline (Measurement C) and divides by the same own-pool gain cell, so a mis-estimated own-pool or static cell shifts all four estimands together.
P5-P2: the placebo bounds the context-length component that is inside every rho numerator, so an unbounded placebo directly biases P2's cell classification.
complementarity_not_proximity.headline: P2

thoughts_do_not_travel.name: thoughts_do_not_travel

predictions.depends_on: F1 (verbatim writer items) vs F2 (deterministic action+observation re-serialization) in 6 cross cells at matched tokens (k raised until F1's token count is reached) and in 3 same-backbone cells; 2 seeds, 4 seeds only for the cross cells whose F1-F2 difference falls inside +/-8 on the first two seeds; Gate 0 requires one cross cell with a >= 6 net verbatim deficit.
predictions.falsifier: Delta_strip <= 0 in the majority of cross cells, or Delta_strip >= +5 in the same-backbone cells.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The only noise figure the proposal states is the +/-8 net floor per cell (about +/-5.7 at 4 seeds) and no paired-Delta CI or MDE is given, so the entire discriminating region between the predicted >= +5 and the falsifying <= 0 lies inside the stated noise; the same-backbone half is a bare equivalence claim (<= 0 within +/-4) at half the floor with no seed upgrade attached to it, and the aggregate escape route is also weak - a perfect 5-of-6 sign test is p = 0.11, so even the ideal result does not exclude the majority-negative falsifier. A second, uncontrolled route to the predicted sign is that the matched-token F2 arm carries strictly more retrieved trajectories than F1, and no stated arm separates extra demonstrations from thought removal.
predictions.fix: State the paired game-level Delta MDE (not the per-cell floor), raise every F1-vs-F2 cell including the three same-backbone cells to the seed count that puts that MDE below 3 net, and pre-register the sign test with a criterion that can reach significance (6 of 6, or per-cell CIs excluding 0 in a stated number of cells).

predictions.depends_on: F4 (model-conditioned rewriter prompt on the reader model, plus the SkillAligner-style execution-time rewrite, no training) vs F2 in the 6 cross cells at 2 seeds, with token cost logged and a memory-absent control on the rewriter prompt.
predictions.falsifier: Delta_rewrite >= +6 net in 2 or more of the 6 cross cells for either rewriter variant.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The falsifier is genuinely reachable (a rewriter can add procedure text or restructure, and the memory-absent control does not bound that), but the +3 equivalence margin and the +6 falsifier sit at or under the stated +/-8 per-cell floor at 2 seeds with no seed upgrade allocated to the F4 cells, so neither the claim nor its falsifier can be resolved; the F4 arm is also not token-matched to F2 in the cell list, so any difference confounds rewriter content with a longer injected context.
predictions.fix: Give the F4 cells the same seed count and paired-Delta MDE as the P1 cells, and add a token-matched F2 comparator for F4 so the >= +6 falsifier is attributable to content rather than to tokens.

predictions.depends_on: [S(F3) - S(F2)] in each cross cell against [S(F1) - S(F2)] measured in the reader's own-pool cells; F3 is one reader pass per item writing its own thought over the foreign action-observation sequence.
predictions.falsifier: The reader's own thoughts on foreign actions add >= 6 net less (or >= 6 more) than its own thoughts add on its own actions.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The estimand is a difference of two Deltas, so its variance is roughly twice a single cell contrast (about +/-11 net at the stated 2-seed +/-8 floor), while the equivalence band is +/-4 and the falsifier is 6 - both far inside the noise; worse, the reference term [S(F1) - S(F2)] in the own-pool cells is the same quantity P1's second clause pins to approximately 0, so under P1 the prediction degenerates into asserting that F3 equals F2 within +/-4, an equivalence at half the noise floor.
predictions.fix: Power the difference-of-differences explicitly (state its paired CI and seed count) and re-anchor it on a term P1 does not already fix - e.g. compare F3 against F1 in the same cross cell with a margin set from the measured own-pool thought contribution rather than from an assumed near-zero one.

predictions.depends_on: The F5 cells for reader Q (E's and G's thoughts attached to Q-self actions, restricted to training games where both the thought source and Q succeeded) against the F2-own cell; 2 seeds, no seed upgrade listed for F5.
predictions.falsifier: S(F5) is within +/-4 of S(F2 own) or better.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: The -5 predicted harm and the +/-4 falsifying band are both inside the stated +/-8 2-seed floor, so neither branch is decidable; in addition the F5 pool is restricted to the both-succeeded intersection of training games while its F2-own comparator is not, so item count and type coverage differ between the arms and any measured harm is partly a retrieval-coverage effect the proposal does not control.
predictions.fix: Run F5 at 4+ seeds with a stated paired MDE below 3 net, and build the F2-own comparator from the same both-succeeded game subset at the same item count so thought provenance is the only difference.

predictions.depends_on: The F6 cells (thoughts with actions removed) against the per-reader static-procedure prompt (Measurement C), 2 seeds.
predictions.falsifier: Thoughts alone give >= 8 net over the static prompt, i.e. the thoughts carry the procedure.
predictions.label: unresolvable
predictions.reason: Reachable - stripped thoughts plausibly restate the ALFWorld procedure - but the falsifying value (8) is exactly the stated 2-seed noise floor and the predicted band (+/-4) is half of it, so a true +8 effect would sit at about one SE and a null result cannot bound the procedure content that P1's interpretation depends on.
predictions.fix: Raise the F6 cells to 4+ seeds and state the placebo criterion as an upper CI bound (e.g. upper bound below 4 net over the static prompt) rather than as a point comparison against the floor.

shared_terms: P1-P3: P3's reference quantity [S(F1) - S(F2)] in the own-pool cells is exactly the same-backbone Delta_strip that P1's second clause fixes near 0, so P1 determines what P3 is comparing against.
P1-P2: Delta_strip and Delta_rewrite are both differences from the same S(F2) cross-cell term, so a single mis-measured F2 cell moves the two in opposite directions.
P3-P4: F3 (own thoughts on foreign actions) and F5 (foreign thoughts on own actions) are scored against the same S(F2 own) reference cell, so an error in that one cell shifts both.
P1-P5: the same per-reader static-procedure and k=0 baselines enter the net points of every Delta, so P5's placebo bounds the procedure component inside P1's Delta_strip.

P2-P3: F4 and F3 are both reader-model passes over the same frozen foreign items and both are scored against S(F2), so a rewriter that mainly re-rationalizes makes Delta_rewrite and [S(F3) - S(F2)] the same measurement.
